name: account-review
title: Commercial account review draft
for_each: select id,name from accounts where not archived order by name

sections.title: Account record
sections.sql: select name,owner,contact_email,reviewed_on from accounts where id=$1

sections.title: Service points
sections.sql: select name,identifier,address,commodity,status from service_points where account_id=$1

sections.title: Agreement dates
sections.sql: select g.name,g.start_on,g.end_on,g.end_on-g.notice_days as notice_on from agreements g join service_points p on p.id=g.point_id where p.account_id=$1

sections.title: Service cases
sections.sql: select c.name,c.status,c.due_on,c.resolution from cases c join service_points p on p.id=c.point_id where p.account_id=$1

name: case-summary
title: Case response preparation draft
for_each: select id,name from cases order by name

sections.title: Recorded facts
sections.sql: select c.name,c.category,c.opened_on,c.due_on,c.status,c.resolution,p.name as site,p.identifier from cases c join service_points p on p.id=c.point_id where c.id=$1

name: renewal-brief
title: Agreement renewal brief draft
for_each: select id,name from agreements where status='active' order by name
